item.description:
Outcome: Procurement

(UYAI) through a Negotiated Acquisition Extension (NAE) for continued services under the Advocate, Intervene, Mentor (AIM) Program. The contract term is July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2028, in the amount of $2,068,000.00.
